mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown in consumer demand and manufacturing output, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline from prior month, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, sustained increases in the federal funds rate compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly job gains (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 (thousands of units), it indicates weakening residential demand that reduces overall economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market stress, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise from prior month, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing output decline that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
